answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent identity to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE); cloning identities requires physical silicon purchase rather than virtual machine duplication. Like indelible pigment embedded into dense walnut grain or resilient juniper fiber, hardware root keys form a unique physical signature. Consensus rejects ephemeral virtual forks, forcing adversaries to acquire dedicated processors to scale validator instances across the decentralized network.
